source_name: ATVP - Registri (securities market agency registers hub)
why_relevant: ATVP maintains public registers of licences for investment services and investment fund management, covering brokerage firms (borznoposredniske druzbe), management companies (druzbe za upravljanje) and banks authorised for investment services. It also licenses individual roles, so its registers expose named licensed persons - a rare register-grade source of individual-level movement in the SI financial sector.

source_name: ATVP - Register odvisnih borznoposredniskih zastopnikov (tied agents register)
why_relevant: Publicly accessible register of tied investment agents established in Slovenia, naming individuals/entities and the firm on whose behalf they act. Changes in this register are a person-level indicator of moves between financial firms - the kind of granular leadership/staff movement other cells cannot confirm.

source_name: ATVP - Seznam javnih druzb (list of public companies)
why_relevant: Enumerates Slovenian issuers subject to disclosure obligations, which includes listed banks. Public-company status is what forces timely disclosure of management and supervisory board appointments, so this list identifies exactly which SI banking employers will produce dated, regulated leadership announcements.

source_name: AJPES Register transakcijskih racunov (RTR)
why_relevant: Register of transaction accounts linking every SI business entity to the bank holding its account. As a pointer it enumerates the set of account-servicing institutions actually operating in SI and lets an analyst map which banks serve which segments - useful for sizing employers and for detecting bank exits/mergers reflected in account migrations.

source_name: European e-Justice Portal - BRIS company search (Slovenia via AJPES)
why_relevant: BRIS queries the Slovenian business register in real time through AJPES, and covers d.d./d.o.o. entities and their cross-border branches. Useful as a fee-free, standardised fallback route to SI entity records - and specifically for spotting SI branches of foreign banking/payments groups and foreign branches of SI institutions, which are organisation-change events.

source_name: AJPES Evidenca digitalnih potrdil zastopnikov (EDP - register of representatives' digital certificates)
why_relevant: A sub-collection of the PRS recording which natural persons are registered as representatives able to act electronically for an entity. Conceptually it is a second, operational confirmation of who currently signs for a bank or payment institution, and changes to it track representation changes.

source_name: Optius.com - Informatika, Programiranje (IT job category)
source_subtype: general job board - IT category page
why_relevant: Where bank/fintech technology roles (core banking, card systems, payment integration, ATM/self-service software) surface even when the employer is classified as an IT vendor rather than a bank. Complements the banking category to catch vendor-side hiring (the small vendors with no visible careers page that this cell is meant to capture).

source_name: Zaposlitev.info - Bančništvo, finance category
source_subtype: general job board - sector category with RSS
why_relevant: Sector-filtered vacancy stream observed with ~12 live banking ads dominated by NLB d.d. (bančni svetovalec, notranji revizor, zakladništvo) across Ljubljana, Domžale, Velenje, Celje, Sevnica, Nova Gorica, Koper. Crucially it exposes a customisable RSS feed per category plus daily/weekly email alerts - the cheapest machine-readable hiring feed found in this cell. Branch-level role geography is a proxy for network/organisation changes.

source_name: Styria digital marketplaces d.o.o. - MojeDelo/bolha operator (ownership pointer)
why_relevant: Establishes that the biggest SI board sits inside the Styria network, which also runs regional marketplaces - useful for anticipating cross-portal syndication of the same vacancy (deduplication) and for finding sister properties that carry the same ads.

source_name: ZRSZ / ESS - Objava prostega delovnega mesta (employer vacancy-notification rules)
why_relevant: Explains the statutory vacancy-notification channel: employers publish vacancies free of charge via the Employer Portal, and the ESS search engine is stated to see 20,000+ jobseeker visits daily. This is the legal backbone that makes the state board the most complete employer census - including small payment/ATM vendors invisible elsewhere.

source_name: PoiščiDelo.si - ESS vacancy search portal
why_relevant: The operational state vacancy database (the near-complete national vacancy register behind ESS). Highest coverage of any SI source for small employers - card personalisation shops, ATM service firms, payment agents - that never appear on commercial boards. Constraint observed: the portal states it is usable only by registered users, with login by email/password or digital certificate, so the ad text is behind authentication.

source_name: ZaDelodajalce.si - ESS employer portal
why_relevant: The submission side of the statutory vacancy flow; confirms how and where banking/payments employers file vacancy notices, and is the counterpart whose publication rules determine what appears in the public register.

source_name: SPOT - Sporočilo o prostem delovnem mestu (obrazec PDM-1)
why_relevant: Documents the PDM-1 vacancy-notification form - the administrative artefact behind every registered SI vacancy. Defines the field set (occupation code, location, contract type, deadline) that any structured collection of SI hiring data should mirror, and confirms the legal duty that makes the state register near-complete.

source_name: EURES European Job Days / EURES portal - Slovenia vacancies
why_relevant: EU-level aggregator that ingests national PES vacancies (Slovenia's ESS is the national EURES member). Gives an alternative, standardised and English-searchable window onto SI vacancies without hitting PoiščiDelo's login wall - valuable precisely because the domestic register is account-gated.

source_name: BetterCareer.si - Slovenian IT job database
why_relevant: Self-described largest SI database of IT positions (software development, QA, DevOps, data science, UI/UX). The natural place for fintech and bank-technology engineering roles that never reach the general banking category - i.e. the leading indicator for payment platform builds at SI banks and vendors.

source_name: Slo-Tech - Zaposlitve (IT community job board)
why_relevant: Slovenia's main IT community site carries a job section where fintech employers post directly - a listing for a C#/.NET developer at a fintech company describing deep knowledge of technology and the payment industry was surfaced via search. Community boards attract small payment vendors that skip paid portals; the adjacent forum threads also reveal employer reputation and staff movement chatter.

source_name: Računalniške novice - Zaposlitveni oglasi
why_relevant: IT trade publication that runs its own vacancy section for programmer/IT-specialist roles. A niche channel used by Slovenian IT and integration houses - including the sort of local vendors serving banks with card, POS and ATM systems - and doubles as an editorial pointer to who is expanding.

source_name: Zaposlitev.net - pioneer SI employment portal (status uncertain)
why_relevant: Named in the seed brief and described in secondary sources as the first Slovenian employment portal, aggregating ads from multiple feeds. Would be a core cell source if live. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: the domain failed DNS resolution from this environment (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND) - this is a hypothesis of a parked/retired or DNS-filtered domain, NOT a verdict. Must be re-checked by the deterministic liveness pass.

source_name: BorzaDela.si / mjob.si - student and temporary work marketplace
why_relevant: Large temporary/student work marketplace (10,000+ listings observed) with an IT category. Direct fetch of a hypothesised banking category returned only warehouse/hospitality student work and no banking employers, so its value for this cell is marginal - but it remains the right surface for back-office/contact-centre surges at banks, which often staff through student work.

source_name: e-Študentski Servis (studentski-servis.com) - student work intermediary
why_relevant: Described as the largest SI student-work intermediary (30+ years, 18 locations). Banks staff branch support, contact centres and back office through student work, so surges here are an early, cheap indicator of retail-network workload changes; it also has a commercial relationship with NLB, useful context on bank-side channel partnerships.

source_name: Adecco H.R. Slovenija - staffing agency vacancies
why_relevant: Major SI staffing agency with branches in all main cities. Agencies publish bank and fintech roles under their own brand (client name withheld), which both hides and reveals: an anonymised 'leading bank' mandate still evidences a hiring wave, and role text leaks system names (core banking, card platform, ATM estate).

source_name: Trenkwalder Slovenija - staffing agency vacancies
why_relevant: One of the larger SI employment agencies (named alongside Manpower, Kariera, ProHuman, Dekra). Same rationale as Adecco: intermediated bank/fintech mandates, including contract and project staffing tied to specific payment programme rollouts.

source_name: Optius Karierna svetovalnica - agency-work explainer (pointer to agency landscape)
why_relevant: Enumerates the larger SI employment agencies - Trenkwalder, Manpower, Kariera, ProHuman, Agado, FMG, Korotaj, Dekra, Trgotur, Atama, Personal Center - giving a ready-made actor list of intermediaries to monitor for bank and payments mandates.

source_name: University of Ljubljana FSD - list of SI job-search websites (portal directory)
why_relevant: An academic career-service directory enumerating SI employment portals (Zaposlitev.net, Zaposlim.se, Moje Delo, Moja Zaposlitev, Kariera and others). Useful as a snowball pointer for portals not surfaced by search engines, though the document is dated and needs liveness re-checking for each listed site.

source_name: LinkedIn - NLB Group company page (jobs + people + posts)
why_relevant: Largest SI banking group; company page carries official appointment posts, job openings and 'people' headcount/function breakdown - earliest public signal of hiring waves and leadership moves.

source_name: LinkedIn - Banka Slovenije (central bank) company page
why_relevant: Central bank page announces board/department appointments and supervisory/payments-unit hiring; regulator organisation changes ripple through the market.

source_name: Bankart careers page (Join our Team)
why_relevant: First-party vacancy list for the SI card processor; an empty vs. full board is itself a demand signal, and role titles reveal technology stack and project direction.
